caption: Onboarding step 3 of 4: 'Multi-channel' (Email, LinkedIn, Calls, SMS) carries the Recommended label and is selected, next to 'Email only'.
After registration the sidebar shows 'Trial: 14 days'; no card was asked for; the account initials are hidden.
CSV import, Map attributes: the contact identifier is Email and the email column maps to Email automatically.
Mapping with a custom field created during import: free_text goes to a new text field, display_name to Full Name (3 of 11 Reply fields); the field ID is hidden.
Import options for the 2 test contacts: Enrich contacts and Find email (2 credits per contact) are switched off by default.
Matched records offers only 'Update missing fields' or 'Skip', so an existing filled field is not overwritten; Find phone number (3 credits per contact) is off.
Import result: 2 imported, 0 updated, 0 skipped, 0 import errors.
Both test contacts selected: the More menu offers Set stage, Blacklist, Unblacklist and Delete, but no export; the account initials are hidden.
Change plan opens on the AI SDR tab with annual billing: $500, $1500 and $10000 a month billed annually.
On Scaling email outreach the slider starts at 25,000 active contacts: Email Volume $259 a month billed annually.
Set to monthly billing and 1,000 active contacts, Email Volume shows $59 a month.
